text:
All panelists unanimously agree on the figures drawn from evidence items E6 and E5.

Answer: The scheduled end-to-end travel time between Orrinford Junction and Tarnside Park is 23 minutes, and trains will run every 6 minutes at peak.

All panelists unanimously agree that dredging will deepen the berth pocket to 17.8 metres, and the terminal's annual capacity after the expansion will be 2.1 million TEU.

Answer: 17.8 metres; 2.1 million TEU.

The three-phase expansion programme will lay a total of 36.7 kilometres of new pipe, comprising 12.4 km in Phase 1, 8.7 km in Phase 2, and 15.6 km in Phase 3.

Answer: 36.7 kilometres

All panelists unanimously agree that mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg in the tirnapexil arm at week 16, and that 19 tirnapexil participants experienced hyperkalaemia.

Answer: Mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg; 19 participants had hyperkalaemia.

All panelists unanimously agree on both figures. The placebo group's FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks, and diarrhoea was the most common adverse event, reported in 22% of olvemarin participants.

Answer: FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks in the placebo group; the most common adverse event was diarrhoea.

All panelists agree that 54 out of 450 participants in the senotrazide arm discontinued the study drug before day 3, yielding 12%.

Answer: 12%

All panelists agree that 252 participants in the pelvastrin arm completed the 24-month follow-up. Starting from 312 randomized participants, 27 withdrew consent, 14 were lost to follow-up, and 19 died, totaling 60 non-completers. The remaining 312 − 60 = 252 completed the follow-up.

Answer: 252

Corvane Logistics' order backlog at year end was $386 million, and the company guided fiscal-2026 revenue growth of 6% to 8%.

Answer: $386 million backlog; 6%–8% revenue growth guidance for fiscal 2026.

All panelists agree that Ostrel Savings Bank's CET1 ratio at year end was 14.3% and its net interest margin for 2025 was 2.17%.

Answer: CET1 ratio 14.3%; net interest margin 2.17%.

All panelists agree: Brightfen Foods' net sales grew from $250 million in fiscal 2024 to $295 million in fiscal 2025, an increase of $45 million. The growth rate is calculated as ($45M / $250M) × 100 = 18%.

Answer: 18%

Tamberlin Software defines free cash flow as operating cash flow minus capital expenditures. For fiscal 2025, operating cash flow was $87.3 million and capital expenditures were $52.9 million, yielding free cash flow of $34.4 million.

Answer: $34.4 million

All five panelists agree that the jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and declined to award punitive damages, citing evidence E4 and E5 respectively.

Answer: The jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and did not award punitive damages.

All panelists unanimously agree that the contractual cap on Solgrave's total liability was 7.5 million euros and the tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros.

Answer: The contractual cap was 7.5 million euros, and the tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros.

The effective date is 18 February 2025 (E2). Payment is due within 45 calendar days, with the day after the effective date counting as day 1 (E3). Counting from 19 February: 10 days in February, 31 days in March (total 41), and 4 days into April reaches day 45 on 4 April 2025.

Answer: 4 April 2025

The defendant has been ordered to pay the plaintiff a total of $2.88 million, comprising $2.35 million in compensatory damages, $0.41 million in prejudgment interest, and $0.12 million in taxable court costs. Legal fees are excluded as not recoverable.

Answer: $2.88 million

The panel unanimously agrees that the tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and was found at a depth of 3.8 metres in the core, as stated in evidence E4.

Answer: The tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and found at a depth of 3.8 metres.

All panelists agree that LXP-9's room-temperature ionic conductivity was measured at 0.84 mS/cm (E2) and that test cells retained 88% of initial capacity after 500 cycles (E4).

Answer: 0.84 mS/cm ionic conductivity; 88% capacity retention after 500 cycles.

The panel unanimously agrees that the terminus retreated 384 metres between the 2008 and 2024 surveys, a span of 16 years. Dividing 384 by 16 yields 24 metres per year.

Answer: 24 metres per year

The number of breeding pairs fell from 1,480 in 2015 to 1,110 in 2025, a decline of 370 pairs. Dividing this by the original 2015 count (370 / 1,480) gives a 25% decline.

Answer: 25%

All panelists agree that evidence E3 states 48,600 patients' records were exposed, and evidence E2 confirms the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025.

Answer: 48,600 patients' records were exposed, and the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025.

All panelists agree based on evidence E3 and E5: an estimated 340 kilograms of ammonia was released, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

Answer: 340 kilograms of ammonia was released, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

The outage began with first errors at 22:47 UTC on 9 October and ended at 03:12 UTC on 10 October, as recorded by the company. The duration is 4 hours and 25 minutes.

Answer: 4 hours and 25 minutes.

All panelists agree: the incident lasted 35 minutes with 1,200 checkout attempts per minute, yielding 42,000 total attempts. Applying the 30% failure rate gives 12,600 failed attempts.

Answer: 12,600
